moments.title: The Hundred continues, Welsh Fire in action
moments.blurb: The Hundred cricket tournament continues across the UK, with Welsh Fire taking on Southern Brave in Cardiff on August 3rd, and more matches throughout the week leading to the final on August 16th.

source.l: The Hundred Official Website / Radio Times

angles.name: Welsh Fire Home Game
angles.copy: Big game for Welsh Fire tomorrow! They face Southern Brave in Cardiff at the Utilita Bowl. Are you heading down or watching on Sky Sports?

angles.name: Tournament Buzz
angles.copy: The Hundred is in full swing! Who are you backing to make it to Finals Day on August 16th? Catch all the action across the UK.

angles.name: Later Welsh Fire Matches
angles.copy: Don't miss Welsh Fire this week! They're at home in Cardiff on August 3rd and again on August 12th against London Spirit. Get behind them!

moments.title: Kathy Brown is 66 today
moments.blurb: American dance and house music singer Kathy Brown, known for hits like 'Turn Me On' and 'Can't Play Around', celebrates her 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Dance Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Sending big birthday vibes to the incredible Kathy Brown! Still sounds amazing 66 years young. What's your favourite track?

angles.name: Tune for the Day
angles.copy: It's Kathy Brown's birthday! Time to crank up 'Turn Me On' and celebrate a true voice of dance music. Happy 66th!

moments.title: James Hetfield turns 63
moments.blurb: James Hetfield, co-founder, frontman, and rhythm guitarist of the legendary heavy metal band Metallica, celebrates his 63rd birthday on August 3rd.

angles.name: Metal Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 63rd birthday to the mighty James Hetfield! What's your ultimate Metallica anthem to celebrate the metal legend?

angles.name: Metallica Shoutout
angles.copy: Raise your horns! James Hetfield of Metallica is 63 tomorrow. Get ready to salute one of rock's biggest voices!

moments.title: Boardmasters Festival kicks off
moments.blurb: The Boardmasters Festival, combining surfing, skateboarding, and music, returns to Newquay, Cornwall from August 5th to 9th, featuring a lineup of diverse artists.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Just three days until Boardmasters takes over Newquay! Sun, surf, and incredible music. Who's heading to Cornwall this week?

angles.name: Westcountry Excitement
angles.copy: Newquay is about to get LOUD! Boardmasters Festival starts Wednesday. Who are you most excited to see on the Cornish coast?

moments.title: Geezer Butler turns 77
moments.blurb: Terence 'Geezer' Butler, the legendary bassist and primary lyricist for Black Sabbath, celebrates his 77th birthday on August 5th.

angles.name: Sabbath Bassist
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the iconic Geezer Butler of Black Sabbath! What's your favourite Sabbath riff or lyric from the master?

angles.name: Metal Pioneer
angles.copy: Celebrating a true pioneer of heavy metal! Geezer Butler is 77 on Wednesday. Still laying down those heavy basslines!

moments.title: Geri Halliwell-Horner is 54
moments.blurb: Geri Halliwell-Horner, famously known as Ginger Spice from the Spice Girls, celebrates her 54th birthday on August 6th.

angles.name: Spice Girl Birthday
angles.copy: Girl Power! Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Ginger Spice, Geri Halliwell-Horner! What's your favourite Spice Girls memory?

angles.name: 90s Pop Icon
angles.copy: It's Geri Halliwell-Horner's birthday on Thursday! Still repping the 90s in style at 54. What's your go-to Spice Girls track?

moments.title: Edinburgh Festival Fringe begins
moments.blurb: The world's largest arts festival, the Edinburgh Festival Fringe, returns from August 7th to 31st, bringing thousands of performances across comedy, theatre, music, and more to Scotland's capital.

angles.name: Fringe Fever
angles.copy: Edinburgh is about to explode with creativity! The Fringe Festival kicks off on Friday. Who's making the trip up north?

angles.name: Scotland's Big Month
angles.copy: It's almost time! The Edinburgh Festival Fringe begins this Friday, transforming our capital into the world's biggest stage. What shows are on your list?

moments.title: Back 2 Festival in Nottinghamshire
moments.blurb: The Back 2 Festival, celebrating music from the 80s, 90s, and 00s, runs from August 6th to 9th in Nottinghamshire, featuring nostalgic acts.

angles.name: Nostalgia Festival
angles.copy: Ready for a trip down memory lane? Back 2 Festival kicks off Thursday in Nottinghamshire, bringing you the best of the 80s, 90s, and 00s! Who's going?

angles.name: Decades Party
angles.copy: Spice up your life and get ready to rave! Back 2 Festival starts soon, celebrating three decades of iconic music. What era are you repping?

moments.title: Bloodstock Open Air Festival
moments.blurb: The UK's largest independent open-air metal festival, Bloodstock Open Air, takes place from August 6th to 9th in Catton Park, Derbyshire, featuring a heavy lineup.

angles.name: Metal Heads Unite
angles.copy: Bloodstock Open Air starts Thursday! Get ready for four days of pure metal mayhem in Derbyshire. Who's heading to Catton Park?

angles.name: Rock Festival Alert
angles.copy: Calling all rock fans! Bloodstock is almost here. Prepare for an epic weekend of heavy bands and mosh pits!

moments.title: Bruce Dickinson turns 68
moments.blurb: Bruce Dickinson, the iconic lead vocalist of Iron Maiden, celebrates his 68th birthday on August 7th.

angles.name: Maiden Frontman Birthday
angles.copy: Up the Irons! Happy 68th birthday to the legendary Bruce Dickinson! What's your favourite Iron Maiden track to celebrate the frontman?

angles.name: Rock Vocalist
angles.copy: Bruce Dickinson is 68 on Friday! Still soaring high with Iron Maiden. What's your favourite live performance of his?

moments.title: Roots Picnic UK debut
moments.blurb: The acclaimed Roots Picnic festival makes its international debut in the UK, taking place at Crystal Palace Bowl, London on August 8th and 9th.

angles.name: London Festival
angles.copy: The Roots Picnic is coming to London this weekend! Crystal Palace Bowl hosts the international debut. Ready for some incredible hip-hop and R&B?

angles.name: New Festival Buzz
angles.copy: Big news for UK music! Roots Picnic makes its debut this weekend. Expect world-class performances and an unforgettable vibe.

moments.title: The Edge (U2) is 65
moments.blurb: David Howell Evans, better known as The Edge, the influential guitarist, keyboardist, and backing vocalist of U2, celebrates his 65th birthday on August 8th.

angles.name: U2 Guitarist Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 65th birthday to the iconic The Edge from U2! His distinctive sound has shaped decades of rock music. What's your favourite U2 track?

angles.name: Guitar Hero
angles.copy: The Edge is 65 this Saturday! Celebrate U2's legendary guitarist by cranking up one of their anthems. What's your pick?

moments.title: Shawn Mendes turns 28
moments.blurb: Canadian singer-songwriter Shawn Mendes, known for hits like 'Stitches' and 'Señorita', celebrates his 28th birthday on August 8th.

angles.name: Pop Star Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 28th birthday to the amazing Shawn Mendes! What's your favourite song from the Canadian pop sensation?

angles.name: Weekend Vibes
angles.copy: Shawn Mendes is 28 on Saturday! Get ready to celebrate with some of his biggest hits. What tune are you playing?

moments.title: European Athletics Championships
moments.blurb: The European Athletics Championships come to the UK for the first time, taking place in Birmingham from August 10th to 16th at the Alexander Stadium.

angles.name: Athletics Excitement
angles.copy: Get ready for world-class athletics! The European Championships kick off in Birmingham on Monday. Who are you cheering on?

angles.name: Birmingham Hosts
angles.copy: Birmingham is about to host the European Athletics Championships for the first time ever! Seven days of thrilling action starts August 10th.

moments.title: Suzanne Vega turns 67
moments.blurb: American singer-songwriter Suzanne Vega, known for her distinctive folk-inspired sound and hits like 'Luka' and 'Tom's Diner', celebrates her 67th birthday on August 10th.

angles.name: Folk Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the brilliant Suzanne Vega! Her unique storytelling has captivated us for decades. What's your favourite track?

angles.name: 80s Classic
angles.copy: Suzanne Vega is 67 on Monday! Time to revisit classics like 'Luka' and 'Tom's Diner'. Still sounds as fresh as ever.

moments.title: Joe Jackson turns 71
moments.blurb: English musician and singer-songwriter Joe Jackson, known for his new wave and pop rock hits including 'Is She Really Going Out with Him?' and 'Steppin' Out', celebrates his 71st birthday on August 11th.

angles.name: New Wave Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to the fantastic Joe Jackson! His sharp lyrics and catchy tunes are truly iconic. What's your favourite of his?

angles.name: 80s Pop Rock
angles.copy: Joe Jackson is 71 on Tuesday! Get 'Steppin' Out' and celebrate one of the UK's great singer-songwriters.

moments.title: Mark Knopfler is 77
moments.blurb: Mark Knopfler, the legendary guitarist, singer, and songwriter best known as the frontman of Dire Straits, celebrates his 77th birthday on August 12th.

angles.name: Dire Straits Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the masterful Mark Knopfler! His guitar work with Dire Straits is simply iconic. What's your favourite track?

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Mark Knopfler is 77 this Wednesday! From 'Sultans of Swing' to his solo work, a true guitar god. What's his best riff?

moments.title: UK Summer Holidays in full swing
moments.blurb: The summer school holidays are ongoing across the UK, with many families enjoying breaks before schools in Scotland and Northern Ireland begin to return mid-August, and England/Wales in early September.

angles.name: Holiday Vibes
angles.copy: Summer holidays are well underway across the UK! Where are you heading for your break, or are you enjoying a staycation?

angles.name: Back to School Countdown
angles.copy: Enjoying the last few weeks of summer holidays? Schools in Scotland and Northern Ireland start heading back soon, with England and Wales following in early September!

moments.title: August UK Weather Outlook
moments.blurb: The UK weather forecast for August predicts continued warm and potentially very warm conditions in the South, with a north-south divide seeing more unsettled weather in northern areas.

angles.name: Warm South, Wet North
angles.copy: August weather update! Looks like the South could see more hot spells, while the North might get more rain. What's the forecast where you are?

angles.name: Summer Sunshine
angles.copy: Hoping for more sunshine this August? Southern UK is tipped for warmer temperatures. Perfect for those beach days in Devon!

moments.title: Premier League season build-up
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season is set to kick off on August 21st, with pre-season preparations and fixture analysis already in full swing.

angles.name: Football Countdown
angles.copy: Only a few weeks until the Premier League kicks off on August 21st! Who are you tipping for the title this season?

angles.name: Pre-Season Talk
angles.copy: Pre-season friendlies are happening, new signings are settling in... the Premier League is almost back! What are your predictions?

moments.title: Great British Bake Off returns in September
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off is confirmed to return for a new season on September 2nd, with Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood as a new judge.

angles.name: Bake Off Buzz
angles.copy: The tent is almost ready! Great British Bake Off returns on September 2nd, and Nigella Lawson is joining as a new judge. Are you excited?

angles.name: New Judge
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson in the Bake Off tent! The new series starts September 2nd. What do you think she'll bring to the judging panel?
